name: Ace Tic Tac Toe
author: Acewebx

sections.description:
This plugin adds a classic Ace Tic Tac Toe game to your WordPress site. It can be embedded on any post or page using the [tic_tac_toe] shortcode. Built with HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, it offers a smooth and responsive experience for both desktop and mobile users.

⚡️ Features

  • Playable directly in the browser with no external dependencies
  • Fully responsive design for all screen sizes
  • Easy to use with the [tic_tac_toe] shortcode
  • Play against the computer (AI) or with a friend (two-player mode)
  • Lightweight and fast-loading
  • Admin customization options:
    • Set game title
    • Set player names (X and O)
    • Change background and button colors
    • Choose between one-player or two-player modes
    • Display WhatsApp contact widget on the game page
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  2. Click Add New, then Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the plugin ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, click Activate.
  5. You will now find the Ace Tic Tac Toe menu in the sidebar. Copy the shortcode and paste it on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

Add the shortcode [tic_tac_toe] to any post or page where you’d like the game to appear.

Can the game be customized?

Yes, the admin can customize various game settings including background color, title, player names, button color, and play mode.

Where can I report a bug?

You can report bugs, suggest ideas, or participate in development by emailing us at developer@acewebx.com.
